name: Manum
description:
About This Game

Manum puts a new spin on the MOBA genre with fast-paced third-person 4v4 combat, free buildcrafting, and capture-point battles. No predefined heroes, no lanes, no minions.

Build your own battlemage from scratch every match, freely combining spells you loot from defeated creatures or trade with allies.

Fight together to claim capture points and destroy the enemy base in matches lasting approximately 25 minutes.

Team up with three other battlemages to fight for capture points. Defeat the creature guarding a point to make it claimable, then battle the enemy team to secure the capture and damage their base. Once captured, the point becomes inactive until its guardian respawns and is defeated again.

Coordinate your team’s attacks to claim points, take down opponents, and destroy the enemy base to win.

Start every match fresh, without predefined heroes or prebuilt spell loadouts. Combine melee attacks, ranged spells, and supportive magic in one build. Focus on a particular playstyle or mix them to create your own. Equip and swap spells as you play, adapting to your team’s needs and the opponents you face.

Your battlemage’s gauntlet lets you slot and combine any spell you find in the arena. How you put them together is in your hands.

Explore combinations of active, passive, and ultimate spells across different elements and schools of magic. Build around one discipline or bring several together, combining precise skill shots, wide-area effects, close-range attacks, and supportive magic.

Collect additional copies of a spell to upgrade it through three levels. Upgrades can do more than increase power: they can change how a spell works and what you can do with it.

Make your fire projectile explode on impact or pull escaping enemies back into your blood totem’s reach. Increase your black hole’s damage with each enemy dragged into its center, or upgrade your healing beam to also damage enemies.
short_desc: A third-person 4v4 MOBA with no predefined heroes, lanes, or minions. Combine spells to build your own hero and fight for capture points.
